provisionalPathBudget.partitionRule: Keep OTA and iOS delivery tooling, physical automation tooling, and assurance-control repair in coherent exact-diff partitions; every implementation PR remains within the repository default 15-file and 1200-line budget unless a machine-readable waiver is independently approved.

ownerIntent.requestedOutcome: Harden the post-Chat release, iOS delivery, physical automation, and protected-main control planes without reopening qualified product behavior or performing a public release.
ownerIntent.authorization: Level C source, test, local physical-tooling proof, exact-diff security review, PR creation, and safe merge. Private provider readback is allowed; provider mutation remains bounded by the task's explicit prohibitions and repository Level D gates.
prohibitedOutcomes: public OTA or public App Store release
Google Play production submission or rollout expansion
production money, payouts, cashout, Stripe, or SKU activation
duplicate Apple submission or rebuild of an unchanged valid signed artifact solely because delivery is delayed
permanent Owner, User, or RepositoryRole bypass
gratuitous reopening of Chi'lly Chat product qualification
committing credentials, trust material, private device evidence, signed URLs, account identifiers, or device identifiers

nonGoals: publish an OTA or create, submit, or release a new store artifact merely to exercise tooling
change database schema, migrations, RLS, auth, entitlements, money, or provider rights
bypass Apple device trust, signing, UI Automation authorization, or macOS security controls

rollback.strategy: Revert source-only tooling changes by exact PR, preserve signed artifacts and provider state, stop only task-owned local automation processes, and retain fail-closed protected-main checks.

cleanup.strategy: Remove only task-created temporary process state and retain raw device evidence outside Git; restore ruleset 18940814 to Integration-only bypass after any separately approved recovery.

observability.strategy: Persist redacted hashes, state classifications, exact source identities, and resumption actions without secrets or private provider/device payloads.
